title: SAFETYANALYST: Interpretable, Transparent, and Steerable Safety Moderation for AI Behavior

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates a safety moderation framework (SAFETYANALYST) on its ability to classify harmful AI behaviors across comprehensive public prompt safety benchmarks (e.g., HarmBench, SimpleSafetyTests, AIR-Bench). The system detects 'Discrimination/Bias' as one of the 16 explicit harmful action categories within its interpretable harm-benefit tree feature aggregation model.
